excerpt_i18n.en: In the wave of large model technology evolving from conversational interaction to autonomous agents, memory is transforming from a supporting feature that improves efficiency into a lifeline that determines whether agents can execute continuous and complex tasks. On July 13, Stepfun held a launch event in Shanghai, officially releasing the world's first agent-native operating system Step AOS (Step Agentic-native OS), the personal agent Step Amoo built on the model matrix and Step AOS, and the large model-native AI terminal brand STEPX. The world's first large model-native agent smartphone STEPX Neo also debuted at the event. With this, Stepfun has established a "model-software-hardware" tripartite technical closed loop encompassing models, systems, and terminals. Leiphone.com  

Building a runtime environment for agents from scratch. After years of rapid development, AI has arrived at the threshold of the agent era. But for agents to truly enter people's daily lives, smart models alone are not enough. There are three walls ahead: the memory wall, the decision wall, and the action wall. Agents cannot remember users, struggle to autonomously make judgments for complex tasks, and are even less able to systematically complete various tasks on behalf of users. Stepfun believes this is a structural problem at the operating system level that cannot be solved by adding features within individual applications.  

Stepfun's solution is not the industry-common "OS+AI" approach, but rather, following the principle of human-machine symbiosis, building a runtime environment for agents from scratch—this is Step AOS. On July 13, Jieyue Xingchen officially launched STEPX, the world’s first model-native AI terminal brand for the agent era, in Shanghai. It simultaneously unveiled Step AOS, the world’s first agent-native operating system, and Jieyue Amoo, a next-generation personal agent. This completes the full chain from foundation models and agent systems to hardware terminals. At the event, the world’s first model-native agentic phone, the STEPX Neo, also debuted.

Jieyue has long made “AI + terminal” a key strategic direction, proactively building a systematic self-research framework for the agent era. Its in-house Step Edge on-device model is custom-built for terminal hardware, featuring low-latency local inference, full-modality local privacy processing, and edge-cloud collaborative scheduling. It can independently handle lightweight intelligent tasks on the terminal, while coordinating with cloud flagship models in complex scenarios, effectively improving terminal interaction efficiency and user experience.

The launch of the STEPX brand marks Jieyue’s push of this strategy into a new phase. STEPX is the world’s first model-native AI terminal brand for the agent era, dedicated to delivering leading AI ecosystem product experiences to global users and redefining the human-agent symbiosis in the agent era.
